calculation.expression: mom20 - mean(mom20) across universe, mom20 = close/close.shift(20) - 1
calculation.description: 20-day momentum of each asset demeaned cross-sectionally against the 15-asset universe average (relative strength). Assets with above-average 20d trend outperform over the 10d horizon; regime-dependent but re-emerged strongly in 2025-26.

validation.regime_notes: Validated on 15-asset cross-asset universe, 653 IC dates with >=8 valid instruments. IC by regime: 2020-22 +0.0655 (ICIR 0.178), 2023-24 -0.0246 (ICIR -0.068, weak), 2025-26 +0.0715 (ICIR 0.185, resurgent). Decay peaks at 20d horizon; turnover 0.246.

signal_artifact.description: Factor signal panel: rows = dates (YYYY-MM-DD), cols = 15 watchlist symbols. Recover with zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(data)).decode() -> pandas.read_csv(StringIO).
